subject: Quick pulse: prioritizing Redwood pilot & outstanding vendor forms
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@citycare.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Quick pulse: prioritizing Redwood pilot & outstanding vendor forms

Hi Emily —

Really enjoyed the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned: 

- Recap: CityCare is looking to run a 6-week pilot (chat + summaries) against support transcripts. Primary goals: latency < 300ms median, PII-safe inference, and < $0.001/token operational target.
- What we promised: pilot SOW + mutual action plan, W-9 & ACH instructions for vendor setup, and a sandbox invite to the Redwood vendor portal so your Ops team can complete tax and payment details.
- Proposed next steps (please confirm owners/timing):
  1) CityCare procurement completes vendor portal onboarding (W-9 + ACH) — target: 1 week
  2) Redwood sends pilot SOW and invoice schedule — target: 2 business days after portal completion
  3) Kickoff technical onboarding once portal + SOW are done — target: mutually available week after that

I attached the mutual action plan and the short recording from today for folks who missed the call. I also included our W-9 in case procurement wants it directly.

Could you confirm whether procurement is the right owner for the portal invite (procurement@citycare.ai) and if the 1-week window is still realistic for you? If priority has shifted, totally fine — just want to re-align on timing so we can hold the slot for your pilot.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0179

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (application/pdf), demo-recording-20260312.mp4 (video/mp4), W9-Redwood-2026.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@citycare.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick pulse: prioritizing Redwood pilot & outstanding vendor forms

Thanks Neha — great recap. I looped in procurement and Samir (finance) — they asked that we send the W-9 and vendor packet directly to procurement@citycare.ai. Procurement also requested our invoice remit info and a copy of the pilot SOW with pricing line items so they can provision a PO.

I expect procurement to be the owner here; they said they will try to turn around the portal completion in 3–5 business days once they have the W-9 and SOW. I marked this high priority on our side but will confirm if anything changes.

Emily
Emily Nguyen
Head of Product, CityCare AI
emily.nguyen@citycare.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@citycare.ai>
Cc: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@citycare.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Files attached again — Redwood W-9 + short SOW for pilot (portal invite pending)

Hi Procurement team —

Following up from Emily — attaching the W-9 and the one-page pilot SOW for CityCare's review. To keep the pilot timeline intact we can:

- Send a DocuSign copy of the SOW now so procurement can sign while you complete the portal, or
- Wait for portal completion and issue a PO against the SOW.

DocuSign link (SOW): https://www.docusign.com/en/unsent/abcdef-portal-link
Vendor portal invite (resend): https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/invite/XYZ-12345

If there are any internal forms we need to complete (vendor code, bank remit template), please share them and we'll fill them today. Our finance lead (Samir on your side?) asked for bank remit details — that's in the W-9 package.

Quick ask: if procurement expects longer than a week for portal completion, could you confirm so we can adjust the technical onboarding slot?

Appreciate it —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: W9-Redwood-2026.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@citycare.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@citycare.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick pulse: prioritizing Redwood pilot & outstanding vendor forms

Looping in Laura from Sales Ops and Marcus to help expedite the vendor onboarding — if procurement needs any alternate remit templates or a single-line invoice example to speed through the portal we can provide them immediately.

Marcus — can your team pre-populate the portal fields we control (SOW summary, pricing table, Redwood tax IDs) and share a 'portal-ready' zip so procurement can upload instead of filling each page? Laura — can we offer a 30-day invoice window and a one-time onboarding credit to help clear internal approvals if they ask?

Emily / Procurement — quick heads-up we can be flexible on the billing terms for the pilot to accommodate CityCare's procurement cadence. Let us know which path makes sense and we'll action it today.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Commercial Sales, Redwood Inference
